title: Clay Sealing
role: Contextual illustration of Minoan sealing technology
caption: Minoan clay sealing, ca. 1600–1450 BCE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 26.31.409. Contextual example.
alt: A small reddish clay sealing with a hole at the top and impressed relief on its face.
credit_display: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Bequest of Richard B. Seager, 1926, accession 26.31.409. Open Access, CC0.
individual_photographer: Not specified in the museum record.
object_creator: Not named in the museum record; culture listed as Minoan.
object_identification: Clay Sealing, Late Minoan I, ca. 1600–1450 BCE, clay, accession 26.31.409. Primary image DP153255.
usage_note: Do not call this an inscribed Linear A sealing or any of PH Wa 32, PH Wa 52, THE Zb 13 or CMS II.6.68. It illustrates sealing material and impressions only. No findspot is supplied in the consulted museum record.
visual_inspection: 1920×1920; clean studio photograph, dark red object on pale background. No visible Linear A text identified.
